scope: Three record tables now reference their existing headings for accessible names. Explicit read-only runtime checks of names, column scopes and intentional desktop/mobile representations; no visual/handler/API changes.

before.finding: Member table had neither caption nor aria name despite a labelled containing section. Same source pattern in leave/posting tables.
before.classification: Accessibility improvement; not a claim that every unnamed table is an automatic WCAG failure.

implementation: Three aria-labelledby attributes referencing existing unique heading IDs; no new visible text/styles/handlers.
limitations: Three loaded record surfaces, not every table or all roles/empty/error states.
One member profile representation is explicitly checked; unit grouping board and desktop posting list intentionally coexist as distinct views.
Three-file source hold only; production build snapshot separately links actual compiled main source. No native AT/physical-device certification.
No broad final runtime/action or all260 completion inferred. Historical main-source reports are marked historical after this edit.
No backend, API contract, permissions, scheduling, saved semantics or export-content changes.
